result.summary: One HallThruster.jl v0.23.1 run can carry N2, N, O2 and O as separate neutral fluids with their own anode flows, inlet velocities and temperatures, their own electron-impact reactions (ionization, dissociation, dissociative ionization, lumped excitation, elastic momentum transfer), cross-species products (O2 -> O + O, O2 -> O+ + O) and per-species charge states. The production N2/N runs (abep-n2n-0.11) already use two neutral species with cross-species products in one run. What the solver cannot express is listed in limitations L-01..L-07: heavy-particle chemistry (including every N / O cross reaction), neutral-surface recombination, dissociative ion-wall neutralization, a faithful electron-loss reaction (dissociative recombination, attachment), negative ions without uncited built-in constants, multiply charged O without a one-to-one charge-state link, and a multi-species feed through the pinned bridge run_case. These are preregistered as omitted processes or bridge additions; no limitation is patched.

capabilities.finding: Config.propellants is a vector of Propellant (v0.19 FluidContainer refactor: 'plasmas containing multiple neutral species are now supported'). Each Propellant carries its own gas, anode flow_rate_kg_s, velocity_m_s, temperature_K, ion_temperature_K, allowed_charges (gas.jl Propellant). Zero-flow species are supported (v0.21.7, #179). Species listed in a propellant_config TOML and not passed as an explicit Propellant are added with flow 0.0 and a velocity scaled by sqrt(M_max / M) from the highest-flow propellant (configuration.jl, 'Add propellants from the file which are not in the config struct'). An explicit Propellant overrides the file's physical properties; default charge / excitation settings are inherited from the file (_merge_propellant_chemistry).
capabilities.consequence: an N2 + N + O2 + O feed with four anode flows is expressible in one Config

capabilities.finding: propellant_config [[reactions]] support type elastic (target_species), excitation (target_species, header energy = lumped loss), electron_impact (equation) and de-excitation (tracked excited states, BETA). An electron_impact equation must have exactly one heavy-species reactant with coefficient 1 (reactions.jl line 254); products may be any configured species of any gas, with integer coefficients; charge balance is checked at parse time (_parse_reaction_equation). Reactions naming an unconfigured excited level are dropped; an unconfigured ground species is an error.
capabilities.consequence: O and O2 ionization, O2 dissociation, O2 dissociative ionization, O / O2 excitation and elastic momentum transfer are expressible exactly as the N2 / N set is

capabilities.finding: allowed_charges / max_charge per species. Species energies are derived only from one-to-one electron-impact reactions within one gas (derive_species_energies, reactions.jl line 158): every configured charge state must be reachable from its gas's ground neutral through one-to-one reactions, otherwise the configuration is refused ('Could not derive the energy of species').
capabilities.consequence: O(2+) can be configured only together with a one-to-one O -> O(2+) or O(+) -> O(2+) table. No such table exists in the repository (Bell et al. 1983 O II and Thompson 1995 double ionization are not in the repository and their hosts are blocked), so O max_charge = 1 in v1; O(2+) production is an omitted process (bounded where a table exists: SONG2026 Table VII sigma(O^2+) from O2). N(2+) is configured as in abep-n2n-0.11 (one-to-one links exist).

capabilities.finding: HallThruster.jl reads '<label> (eV): <E>' + column header + (mean energy, k) rows, interpolates linearly onto 0:1:255 eV mean energy and clamps the lookup index to the table ends (the end value is held beyond 255 eV).
capabilities.consequence: the same table format, 0-300 eV writer grid and rate_validity.toml semantics as abep-n2n apply; the bridge chemistry_validity guard (f_out = 0) applies per table

capabilities.finding: With ion_wall_losses = true, each positive-ion fluid loses density at the Bohm-scaled wall rate and the mass is returned to the ground neutral of the ion's own propellant group (apply_ion_wall_losses!, heavy_species_update.jl line 916-946): O2+ -> O2, O+ -> O, N2+ -> N2, N(2+) -> N; negative ions are excluded. At the anode the positive-ion outflow is returned as the ground neutral of the same propellant group (apply_left_boundary!, line 303-430). Neutrals have no wall interaction: no neutral wall loss and no surface recombination (O + wall -> 1/2 O2, N + wall -> 1/2 N2).
capabilities.consequence: dissociative wall neutralization of molecular ions and in-channel neutral-surface recombination are not representable (limitations L-02, L-03); the envelope keeps the registered v1 setting ion_wall_losses = false

capabilities.finding: Facility ingestion splits the background density between propellants by their anode number-flow fraction (params_from_config, configuration.jl line 448-460).
capabilities.consequence: not exercised: the envelope is vacuum mode (flight); no facility interpretation enters

capabilities.finding: No configurable heavy-particle reaction type exists. The only heavy-particle source terms are built in for negative ions: mutual neutralization A- + B+ and neutral-induced detachment A- + M with hard-coded k = 1.0e-12 m^3/s each (_K_MUTUAL_NEUTRALIZATION, _K_NEUTRAL_DETACHMENT, heavy_species_update.jl lines 732, 735; comment 'lit. ~4e-14 to ~1e-12', no citation), applied to every fluid with Z < 0. There is no ion-molecule reaction (O+ + N2 -> NO+ + N, N2+ + O -> NO+ + N, charge transfer N2+ + O -> O+ + N2), no neutral-neutral reaction (N + O2 -> NO + O), no three-body reaction and no ion-neutral charge-exchange or momentum collision.
capabilities.consequence: every N / O cross reaction and every NO / NO+ formation channel is outside the solver (limitation L-01); configuring O- would import the uncited constants (limitation L-05)

capabilities.finding: An equation such as 'O2(+) + e -> O + O' or 'O2 + e -> O(-) + O' parses (one heavy reactant, charge balanced). But (a) any channel whose product charge differs from the reactant charge is flagged ionizing and adds to nu_iz (_is_ionizing, line 560; nu_iz enters the classical electron collision frequency, collision_frequencies.jl), (b) the electron energy equation has no sink for the thermal energy of the removed electron beyond the fixed header energy (electron_energy.jl line 279; n_e follows from quasineutrality), (c) attachment needs O(-) as a fluid, which triggers C-07.
capabilities.consequence: dissociative recombination and attachment are not faithfully representable (limitation L-04); both are preregistered as omitted processes bounded by F_e_loss

capabilities.finding: Elastic tables enter the electron-neutral momentum collision frequency per target species; no elastic recoil energy term 3 m_e / M (T_e - T_g) appears in the electron energy equation.
capabilities.consequence: a solver model-form property common to every family (Xe, N2_PROXY, AIR); F_P is defined on inelastic power only, as in the N2 precedent

capabilities.finding: Excitation tables are lumped energy losses at their header energy; tracked excited fluids (v0.23 BETA) need user-supplied de-excitation half-lives and are not used.
capabilities.consequence: same treatment as abep-n2n (excited-state populations are not tracked; stepwise ionization and superelastic return are omitted processes)

capabilities.finding: hallthruster_bridge/bridge_lib.jl run_case feeds only N2 when a propellant_config is given (kw[:propellants] = [het.Propellant("N2", flow_rate_kg_s=c.mdot_kgps)]); every other configured species then enters with zero anode flow. bridge_lib.jl is pinned by NP-HALL-PARAMETRIC-ENVELOPE v1 (prereg_v1.json pinned_inputs) and is not edited. chemistry_reactions / chemistry_activity / chemistry_validity, reactant_term, reactant_density, measured_bfield and wall_ion_metrics work unchanged for several neutral species and charge states.
capabilities.consequence: a multi-species feed needs an additive run function in a new driver file that reuses the bridge helpers (limitation L-07)

limitations.what: no heavy-particle reactions (ion-molecule, charge transfer, neutral-neutral, three-body), hence no N / O cross chemistry and no NO / NO+
limitations.handling: omitted processes in the preregistered audit; with no sourced rate in the repository they are UNBOUNDED_OMISSION; if any is promoted the AIR set is NOT_REPRESENTABLE_IN_PINNED_SOLVER

limitations.what: no neutral-surface recombination in the channel (O + wall -> 1/2 O2, N + wall -> 1/2 N2)
limitations.handling: omitted process bounded with the physical recombination-probability envelope [0, 1]; feed-side recombination is covered separately by the composition envelope (f_O down to 0)

limitations.what: molecular-ion wall / anode neutralization returns the parent molecule only (O2+ -> O2, never 2 O)
limitations.handling: structural; inactive in the envelope wall setting (ion_wall_losses = false), active at the anode; recorded as a model-form limitation

limitations.what: electron-loss reactions (dissociative recombination, attachment) not faithfully representable
limitations.handling: omitted processes bounded by F_e_loss (attachment: SONG2026 Table VIII bound table; dissociative recombination: no source in the repository -> UNBOUNDED_OMISSION)

limitations.what: negative ions carry uncited built-in sink constants (1e-12 m^3/s)
limitations.handling: O- is never configured; if attachment is promoted, AIR is NOT_REPRESENTABLE_IN_PINNED_SOLVER

limitations.what: O(2+) needs a one-to-one charge-state link with no repository source
limitations.handling: O max_charge 1; O(2+) channels are omitted processes (tier 3)
additive AIR driver function (new file) reusing the bridge helpers; bridge_lib.jl unchanged

options_if_a_limitation_binds: O-A: record the AIR Hall chemistry as NOT_REPRESENTABLE_IN_PINNED_SOLVER and keep AIR layer (a) NOT_EVALUATED (default; no owner action needed)
O-B: a single-species O-only (or O2-only) family as a labelled bounding diagnostic, like N2_PROXY (no classification effect unless the owner rules a bound)
O-C: an owner-approved HallThruster.jl upgrade or extension: a physics-model change under PINNED.toml upgrade_policy (pin bump on a branch, P5 reruns, HISTORY), never automatic
conclusion: Not a stop condition. The preregistration proceeds with a multi-species AIR reaction set for the pinned solver and treats L-01..L-06 as omitted processes or structural limitations, and L-07 as an additive driver.
